story.title: South Korea's Education Minister Resigns Amid AI Cheating Controversy
story.summary: Choi Kyo-jin, South Korea's education minister, has stepped down following backlash over last-minute security measures aimed at preventing AI-assisted cheating during the college entrance exam. The measures, which included the use of hidden cameras and smart glasses, sparked significant criticism and chaos during the exam process.

timeline_highlights.title: South Korean Education Minister Resigns Amid AI Cheating Scandal
timeline_highlights.summary: Choi Kyo-jin, South Korea's education minister, resigned following an AI-assisted cheating scandal that emerged just before the Suneung university entrance exam. He acknowledged a failure to adequately prepare for the exam security measures, which led to chaos during the testing period. The scandal was triggered by a confession from a top scorer in a national tax accountancy exam who admitted to using a miniature camera and smartphone to cheat.

event_overview.title: About Education Scandal
event_overview.subject: Education Scandal
event_overview.summary: This controversy concerns South Korea’s emergency response to fears that generative AI and concealed smart devices could be used to cheat on high-stakes national examinations. It culminated in political accountability over last-minute safeguards for the 2027 College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT, or Suneung), rather than an established finding that all detected electronic-device cases involved AI-assisted cheating.

facts.label: Trigger and timing
facts.value: The government convened an emergency meeting on November 15, 2026, after allegations that the top scorer in the certified tax accountant examination had used AI in cheating; the meeting was intended to protect fairness and public trust across national examinations, including the imminent CSAT.

facts.label: Exam at the center
facts.value: The CSAT is South Korea’s annual national college entrance examination. The 2027 academic-year test was held nationwide on November 19, 2026, with score notices scheduled for December 11, 2026.

facts.label: Responsible institutions
facts.value: The Education Ministry leads the education-side response; the Korean Institute for Curriculum and Evaluation handles CSAT question-and-answer publication and objections. The post-exam government task force also includes science, justice, interior, anti-corruption, police and AI-strategy bodies.

facts.label: Measures and enforcement
facts.value: Authorities adopted enhanced screening and supervision intended to detect AI-capable or other smart devices. After the exam, the government said it would analyze recorded Wi-Fi and Bluetooth signals, refer suspicious cases for investigation, and pursue legislation that could restrict future CSAT eligibility for smart-device cheating by up to 10 years.

facts.label: Political outcome
facts.value: Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin offered his resignation on November 22, 2026, taking responsibility for confusion caused by late anti-cheating rule changes; President Lee Jae Myung accepted it the same day.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers the ministerial resignation and immediate controversy around the 2026 CSAT safeguards, not every alleged cheating case, investigation, prosecution, or longer-term examination-policy change.

related_stories.title: Rep. Jimmy Gomez to Resign Following Ethics Committee Findings of Sexual Misconduct
related_stories.summary: Representative Jimmy Gomez has announced his resignation effective December 1 after a House Ethics Committee found substantial evidence of sexual misconduct, including unwanted sexual advances towards a staffer. Gomez disputed the allegations but stated that he felt he had no choice but to resign.

related_stories.title: Reactions to Jensen Huang's Reinstatement at Nvidia Amid Controversy
related_stories.summary: Jensen Huang has been reinstated as CEO of Nvidia following controversy surrounding his alleged involvement with a Chinese spy. Some Republicans have expressed condemnation of his return, while experts have described the situation as a significant economic reversal. Huang is expected to testify regarding his connections to the alleged spy.

related_stories.title: India Commits $1.6 Billion in Flood Relief to Nepal During Prime Minister's Visit
related_stories.summary: India has pledged $1.6 billion in flood relief to Nepal as Prime Minister Balendra Shah visits New Delhi. This marks Shah's first international trip since taking office in March. The visit also resulted in agreements on infrastructure projects, including a railway and a hydropower plant.
